expanded_estimand.name: clinical benefit and recurrence association with regimen-aligned PDO summaries
expanded_estimand.treatment_scope: includes explicitly tagged partial components, analogs, separate-drug means and active-moiety matrices
expanded_estimand.endpoint_scope: PR/CR/SD benefit or source recurrence-free followup; duration-only >=6 months tagged separately
expanded_estimand.selection: earliest evaluable post-sampling episode per patient; author exclusions retained; no score-based selection
expanded_estimand.response_interpretation: mixed clinical-benefit endpoint, not uniform RECIST objective response
expanded_estimand.analysis_type: retrospective; outcomes historically visible; S58 estimand expansion is not prospective validation
expanded_estimand.cluster_independence: distinct source study cohorts; same-study episodes deduplicated; global undocumented cross-study identity remains unknown
